tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Search bookable hotels by location and dates. Returns hotels with nightly prices, photos, coordinates, a `url` linking to the hotel on Pilot, and an opaque id to pass to get_hotel_details and get_rates. Booking is not available through this connector, so link the user to a hotel's `url` when they want to book. Narrow with the rating, amenity and radius filters rather than requesting a large limit, and page with offset using next_offset from the previous result.

children_ages.description: Ages of children sharing the room

guest_nationality.description: ISO-2 country of the guest; affects rate eligibility

radius_meters.description: Restrict to this radius around the location

min_star_rating.description: Only hotels at or above this star rating

min_guest_rating.description: Only hotels at or above this guest review score, out of 10

amenity_ids.description: Supplier facility ids the hotel must offer

property_type_ids.description: Supplier hotel-type ids to restrict to

ai_search.description: Free-text preference, e.g. 'boutique hotel near the old town'. Ignored when it matches no inventory.

tools.name: get_hotel_details
tools.description: Get static details (description, amenities, photos, address) for a hotel id returned by search_hotels.

tools.name: get_room_rates_for_hotel
tools.description: Get room rates for a hotel id from search_hotels. Each offer includes a price, board type and refundability. Booking is not available through this connector; send the user to Pilot to book.
